headline: Commissioner appointments and reassignments to Policy and Finance committees, a School Safety committee seat, and a School Liaison role.
summary: The meeting will discuss and possibly act on assigning commissioners to committees and as a school liaison. Items cover the Policy Committee, Finance Committee, School Safety Committee, and School Liaison role.
items: Appointment or reassignment of commissioners to the Policy Committee
Appointment or reassignment of commissioners to the Finance Committee
Appointment of a commissioner to the School Safety Committee
Appointment of a commissioner to be a School Liaison
location: BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 06010
plain_text:
Special Board of Education Meeting 
Wednesday, September 23, 2026 5:45 PM 
BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 
06010
